name: Bankr
rootCause: The Bankrbot X account (despite on-device passkey) was compromised and posted fake airdrop links; concurrently, the project's Bankr wallet (without MFA) was drained of ~1.5 billion $BNKR tokens which were then dumped.

descriptions.text: The Bankrbot X account (despite on-device passkey) was compromised and posted fake airdrop links; concurrently, the project's Bankr wallet (without MFA) was drained of ~1.5 billion $BNKR tokens which were then dumped.

On 2026-07-25, Bankr's official @bankrbot X account was reportedly compromised and used to post a fake airdrop link. Public incident tracking associated the event with a reported $479,885 loss on Base, and Bankr later said no Bankr contract vulnerability or infrastructure breach was involved. Available evidence indicates unauthorized takeover of Bankr's official @bankrbot X account. The attacker used that trusted social identity to publish a fake airdrop link. Bankr later said its infrastructure and product were not compromised, and no Bankr smart contract bug has been publicly identified for this event. The exact X-account compromise path and the wall…
